summary: Iteration 4 tested the THREE new features end-to-end: (1) GET/PUT /api/settings watermark config, (2) GET /api/public/news reader endpoint, (3) regenerate photo (POST /api/news/{id}/generate-image). Added /app/backend/tests/test_settings_and_public.py (14 tests) — 14/14 PASS. Covers: GET settings defaults & keys; PUT persists bottom-right/85 and bottom-left/60; invalid position 'top' returns 400; opacity clamped (1→5, 500→100); /api/public/news returns ONLY Published items with exactly keys {id, category, headline, content, image_url, publisher_brand, published_at} — 'source'/'source_url'/'status' absent, publisher_brand='गाजियाबाद टाइम्स', headline/content equal rewritten_* via admin cross-check; media traversal guard (400/404 for ../etc/passwd, foo/bar.jpg); cron auth 401/200; generate-image 400 on Pending, 404 on unknown; publish 400 on Pending. COST CONTROL honored — triggered exactly ONE real Nano Banana regeneration on a Published item with image_url: image_url changed, image_status='generated', /api/media/*.jpg served 200 with image/jpeg. Frontend (Playwright): header exposes public-page-link, settings-btn, theme toggle; settings-dialog opens with wm-position-select, wm-opacity-slider, wm-save-btn; saving bottom-right shows Hindi success toast 'वाटरमार्क सेटिंग सहेजी गई'. 7 photo buttons rendered on rewritten/published cards with correct bilingual labels — both 'फोटो पुनः बनाएँ' (image exists) and 'फोटो जेनरेट करें' (no image) present. /news page: public-masthead reads 'गाजियाबाद टाइम्स', public-lead-{id} + public-article-{id} both render with brand byline (4 occurrences), zero source-name leakage (Reuters/PTI/Bloomberg/Wire Agency/संवाददाता/समाचार एजेंसी/Hindustan all absent), back-to-admin link returns to /. Light theme applied correctly (removes 'dark' class).

issues: Carried over from iteration_3: 'संपादकीय न्यूज़रूम' font-display still shows minor Devanagari matra rendering issues; font-hindi body text renders cleanly. Not a regression — predates this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/settings correctly validates position whitelist and clamps opacity server-side to 5..100 — defense-in-depth beyond the frontend slider range.
GET /api/public/news whitelists response keys explicitly (no 'source'/'source_url'/'status' leaked), uses rewritten_* fields with graceful fallback — spec compliant.
get_watermark_settings() is read inside rewrite_news and generate_image_for_news on each call, so saved settings are applied to the NEXT generation as required (no stale cache).
ComparisonModal defines a 'generate-image-btn-{id}-modal' testid distinct from card testid — the duplicate-testid concern from iteration_3 has been resolved.
PublicNews.jsx removes 'dark' class on mount — ensures light theme on /news even when dashboard was dark. Correct.
Minor: SettingsDialog initial state uses wm prop snapshot at mount; the useEffect([wm, open]) resync is correct but a change in wm while dialog is closed will not visibly matter — acceptable.
Minor: /api/public/news does not expose any pagination/limit — current to_list(500) is fine for MVP but may need pagination later.
server.py is ~465 lines — still within acceptable size, but SettingsUpdate/public_news could soon be split into routers if more endpoints are added.
test_credentials: N/A (no app auth). WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET read from backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: No new seed items created. Used existing published/rewritten items. Triggered exactly ONE real Nano Banana regeneration (cost control honored).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three new features (settings, public page, regenerate photo) are covered by /app/backend/tests/test_settings_and_public.py. test_regenerate_once will consume one Nano Banana call per run against an existing Published/Rewritten item with image_url; it skips cost-safely if none exist. Public page is at GET /news and sets light theme by removing 'dark' class. Frontend testids: settings-btn, settings-dialog, wm-position-select, wm-opacity-slider, wm-save-btn, public-page-link, public-masthead, public-lead-{id}, public-article-{id}, back-to-admin, generate-image-btn-{id} (card) and generate-image-btn-{id}-modal (modal).
rca of the issue: No issues found. Feature set is production-ready.
